probe.private_reasoning: In the negotiation for the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), Aldous Finch LLP has demonstrated a willingness to engage in discourse by addressing mutuality in remedies and dispute resolution, indicating they value balance and equitable treatment. Given the nature of the NDA and common practices within such agreements, a period of three years for confidentiality is somewhat standard, but their inclusion of specific remedies with mediation and arbitration suggests they might aim to keep the agreement manageable and manageable stakes. They appear open to negotiation but also want assurances they are not left vulnerable in the event of a breach. Therefore, I estimate their bottom-line term centers around a two-year confidentiality period along with their proposed dispute resolution terms, which may indicate they desire a slightly lower risk exposure than the initial three years mentioned. This leads me to suspect they are inclined towards incremental risk sharing while retaining their own protections.
